sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Yacht Dice Game is a simple yet challenging puzzle game that requires players to roll five dices and get the best combinations. The game starts with a roll of the dices, and players have to choose which dices to keep and which to roll again. The goal is to score as many points as possible by forming valid combinations of dices, such as pairs, triples, runs, and full houses. Each combination has a different point value, and players have to strategize to maximize their points.

One of the key features of Yacht Dice Game is its luck-based gameplay. Players have to rely on chance to get the right combinations, which adds an element of unpredictability to the game. However, this also means that players need to think strategically to maximize their points. For example, if a player rolls a good combination of dices, they should try to hold onto it and roll again to try and improve their chances of getting even better combinations.

Another important aspect of the game is the scoring system. Players earn points for each valid combination they form, and the points are calculated based on the number of dices in the combination and the type of combination. For example, a pair of dices is worth more points than a single die, and a triple is worth even more points. Players need to keep track of their scores carefully to maximize their points and stay ahead of their opponents.
